description: This file defines an abstract class for handling Buzz Video URLs within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a constructor, a getter for the URL, and an abstract method for obtaining the embedded URL, utilizing traits and custom exceptions.

classes.name: AbstractBuzzVideoURL
classes.description: An abstract class that encapsulates the behavior for Buzz Video URL handling, requiring subclasses to implement a method for obtaining the embedded URL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a URL string.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL stored in the object.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the embedded URL, intended to be implemented by subclasses.
